facts.text: The two main islands are Te Ika-a-Māui and Te Waipounamu.
Kiwi and kākāpō are distinctive native flightless birds.

culture.text: Te reo Māori is a living Indigenous language heard in broadcasting, education, and place names.

food.name: Hāngī
food.text: Food is slowly steam-cooked over heated stones in a covered earth oven, often for gatherings.
